narrative:
## Handover Summary — Patient Volume & Diagnosis

Patient curves are validated for all brand-indications in scope; 12-month persistence holds at 91%.

## Key Decisions
• gMG patient curve raised on claims-based diagnosis acceleration
• Koselugo China ramp lifted after the NRDL listing
• Strensiq US adult HPP conversion assumption set at 30%

## Recommendation for Launch & Lifecycle
The Lifecycle Lead should reconcile the Soliris-to-Ultomiris switch volumes with the biosimilar erosion curve, so that patients are not double-counted across brands.

signals.title: gMG Claims Analysis — Diagnosis-to-Treatment Time
signals.excerpt: Median time from gMG diagnosis to complement inhibitor start fell from 14 to 9 months. AChR+ antibody testing up 22% YoY.

signals.title: Adult HPP Screening Programme Results
signals.excerpt: Low ALP screening flagged 410 undiagnosed adult HPP candidates; ~30% conversion to Strensiq over 18 months.
